name: Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students (Maharashtra)
description: State scheme of the VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department for OBC students in approved post-matric courses. Parent/guardian annual income up to ₹2.5 lakh. Only 2 boys per parents are eligible (any number of girls). 75% attendance is mandatory. Professional courses must be entered through the CAP round. NOTE: the MahaDBT scheme page states the ₹2.5 lakh limit, but some third-party sites quote ₹1.5 lakh with a non-creamy-layer certificate — confirm on the portal before applying.
benefits: Tuition fee + exam fee + monthly maintenance allowance (hosteller ₹150–425/month, day scholar ₹90–190/month depending on course group). 100% benefit for girls (GR of 8 July 2024). In private unaided/non-government institutes tuition and exam fees are 50%.
source_organization: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, Govt of Maharashtra (MahaDBT)
required_documents: Caste certificate (issued by Govt of Maharashtra)
Caste validity certificate (mandatory for professional degree & PG courses)
Gap certificate (only if there is a gap)
Ration card (to show number of children)
Parents' declaration about number of children

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti (EBC) — Directorate of Art courses
description: Fee-reimbursement scheme for economically weaker students of open (general) category who took admission to professional courses under the Directorate of Art. Family income up to ₹8 lakh. Only the first two children are eligible. Not for distance, virtual or part-time courses. You must not receive any other scholarship or stipend. The same scheme name also runs under other departments (Higher Education, Technical Education, Medical, Agriculture) for their courses — check which applies to your course.
benefits: Girls: 100% tuition fee for professional courses (and non-professional up to ₹8 lakh) plus 100% exam fee. Boys: 50–100% depending on income (up to ₹2.5 lakh vs ₹2.5–8 lakh), type of college and course. See the official scheme page for the full table.
source_organization: Directorate of Art, Govt of Maharashtra (MahaDBT)

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Tuition Fee Scheme for Girls (100% tuition + exam fee)
description: Fee-reimbursement scheme for economically weaker students (EBC / EWS / SEBC) of Maharashtra. Family income up to ₹8 lakh. Since AY 2024-25 girls get 100% of tuition and exam fee. Runs under several departments (Technical, Higher, Medical Education, Agriculture, Art) — apply under the department of your course. The document list below is partial; the portal may ask for more.
benefits: 100% tuition fee + 100% exam fee for girls. Paid in two instalments to your Aadhaar-linked bank account (per DTE Maharashtra).
source_organization: Directorate of Technical Education & other departments, Govt of Maharashtra (MahaDBT)

name: Post Matric Scholarship to VJNT Students (Maharashtra)
description: State scheme of the VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department for Vimukta Jati & Nomadic Tribes students in approved post-matric courses, Class 11 up to PhD. Parent/guardian annual income up to ₹1.5 lakh. Must be a resident of Maharashtra. The document list below is partial; see the official scheme page for the full list.
benefits: Tuition fee + exam fee + monthly maintenance allowance (hosteller up to ₹425/month for Course Group A; other groups and day-scholar rates are lower — see the scheme page).
source_organization: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, Govt of Maharashtra (MahaDBT)

name: Post Matric Scholarship to SBC Students (Maharashtra)
description: State scheme of the VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department for Special Backward Class (SBC) students in approved post-matric courses (Class 11 onwards). Parent/guardian annual income up to ₹1.5 lakh. Must be a resident of Maharashtra. Only 2 boys of the same parent are eligible. 75% attendance is mandatory. Professional courses must be entered through the CAP round.
benefits: Tuition fee + exam fee + monthly maintenance allowance (up to ₹425/month for hostellers in Course Group A; other groups and day-scholar rates are lower). See the scheme page for the full table.
source_organization: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, Govt of Maharashtra (MahaDBT)
required_documents: Caste validity certificate (mandatory for professional degree & PG courses)
Parents' declaration about number of beneficiary children

name: State Minority Scholarship Part I — Professional & Technical Courses (DTE)
description: For students of Maharashtra's notified minority communities (Muslim, Buddhist, Christian, Sikh, Parsi, Jain, Jewish) in diploma, degree or PG professional/technical courses. Family income up to ₹8 lakh. You must have passed SSC from Maharashtra and hold a Maharashtra domicile. Admission through CAP or institute level. You must not receive any other scholarship or stipend. The document list below may be shorter than the portal's.
benefits: Actual annual tuition + exam fee or ₹50,000, whichever is less (per DTE Maharashtra, from AY 2022-23).
source_organization: Minority Development Department / Directorate of Technical Education, Govt of Maharashtra (MahaDBT)
required_documents: Income and minority declaration (affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper, employer income certificate, or self-declaration)
School leaving certificate (accepted as proof of minority)
amount: Fees or ₹50,000 a year (whichever is less)

name: State Minority Scholarship Part II — Arts, Commerce, Science, Law, Education (DHE)
description: Post-matric state scholarship for minority students in graduation or post-graduation in Arts, Commerce, Science, Law or Education. Maharashtra domicile and family income up to ₹8 lakh. Only 2000 new (fresher) applicants get a seat under the quota, so apply early. Maharashtra students studying outside Maharashtra cannot apply. Based on GR dated 14.10.2011.
benefits: Total annual course fee or ₹5,000, whichever is less.
source_organization: Minority Development Department / Directorate of Higher Education, Govt of Maharashtra (MahaDBT)
amount: Fees or ₹50,000 a year (whichever is less)

name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Hostel Maintenance Allowance (Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta)
description: Hostel maintenance allowance for Maharashtra students in professional/technical courses (admitted through CAP) who live in a hostel. Open / EWS / SEBC category, family income up to ₹8 lakh (the Directorate of Art version says ₹6 lakh). Only 2 children per family. Seats: children of small-land-holder farmers or registered labourers and EBC students up to ₹1 lakh income are all eligible; EBC students above ₹1 lakh compete for 500 seats per district (33% for girls). Not for private/deemed universities. You must not take any other maintenance allowance or stipend, need 50% attendance, and no gap of 2+ years. The same scheme runs under several departments — check the one for your course.
benefits: 10 months per year. Per DTE summaries, up to ₹30,000/year (₹3,000/month) in Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur and similar cities, or ₹20,000/year (₹2,000/month) elsewhere — confirm exact amounts on the portal.
source_organization: Directorate of Higher / Technical Education and other departments, Govt of Maharashtra (MahaDBT)
required_documents: Registered Labour / Alpabhudharak (marginal land holder) certificate, or family annual income certificate
Hostel proof (hostel admission, or rent agreement with owner for private hostel/PG)
